007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.databaseadmin;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.DatabaseAdmin;
010import oracle.jdbc.pool.OracleDataSource;
011import org.slf4j.Logger;
012import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
013
014import javax.sql.DataSource;
015import java.sql.SQLException;
016
017/**
018 * Sample for creating a DataSource-backed DatabaseAdmin client.
019 *
020 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to configure an Oracle JDBC {@link DataSource},
021 * create a DataSource-backed {@link DatabaseAdmin} client, and close it after
022 * use. Administrative methods on {@code DatabaseAdmin} require a database user
023 * authorized to perform the requested setup operation.</p>
024 *
025 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
026 * <ul>
027 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
028 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
029 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
030 * </ul>
031 *
032 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
033 * <pre>{@code
034 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
035 * }</pre>
036 *
037 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
038 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
039 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
040 * <pre>{@code
041 * mvn clean install
042 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
043 * }</pre>
044 *
045 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
046 * <pre>{@code
047 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
048 *   -d samples/out \
049 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/databaseadmin/CreateDatabaseAdminDataSourceSample.java
050 * }</pre>
051 *
052 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
053 * <pre>{@code
054 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
055 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.databaseadmin.CreateDatabaseAdminDataSourceSample
056 * }</pre>
057 *
058 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
059 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
060 * and diagnostics.</p>
061 */
062public final class CreateDatabaseAdminDataSourceSample {
063    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CreateDatabaseAdminDataSourceSample.class);
064
065    private CreateDatabaseAdminDataSourceSample() {
066    }
067
068    public static void main(String[] args) {
069        try (DatabaseAdmin ignored = DatabaseAdmin.create(dataSource())) {
070            System.out.println("Created DataSource-backed DatabaseAdmin client.");
071        } catch (Exception e) {
072            LOGGER.error("Failed to create DataSource-backed DatabaseAdmin client.", e);
073        }
074    }
075
076    static DataSource dataSource() throws SQLException {
077        OracleDataSource dataSource = new OracleDataSource();
078        dataSource.setURL(CreateDatabaseAdminWithOptionsSample.requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"));
079        dataSource.setUser(CreateDatabaseAdminWithOptionsSample.requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"));
080        dataSource.setPassword(CreateDatabaseAdminWithOptionsSample.requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"));
081        return dataSource;
082    }
083}
